title: Week of Oct 26
text: Written Oct 23 from LinkedIn and Instagram posts published Oct 6–22 (Supermetrics). Compared with September's posts. Reads are hypotheses until the experiments confirm them.

title: Guest interviews carried LinkedIn; Awards nominee posts did not.
text: 22 of 46 LinkedIn posts were Moment Awards Top 20 nominee posts. They drew a median 239 impressions and 16 comments in all, a fifth of the period's impressions. The 16 guest interviews drew a median 661 impressions and 67 comments. Topics that travelled were personal or pointed: Sharb Farjami (Reddit) on humans as the centre of the industry, Caitlin Coburn Winsor (PepsiCo) on raising her hand, and two women's health posts (Organon, Clue).

title: On Instagram, reach came from tagged accounts, not from single-guest reels.
text: The Top 20 carousel tagged about 30 brand accounts and reached 4,075 accounts with 24 shares, the best post of the period. Honoree reels that tagged the honoree and their company also did well: Sara Fischer (Axios) drew 139 likes and 21 comments, and Michelle Crossan-Matos (SharkNinja) reached 1,610. The 13 single-guest reels had a median reach of 198, below September's median of 300 per post. Instagram's 28-day reach is 30.0K, down 31% on the 28 days to Sep 24.

title: More LinkedIn posts did not add up to more reach.
text: The page posted 46 times in 17 days (2.7 a day, against 1.6 a day in September) and the median post reached 281, down from 389 in September. Busy days did not lift the day: Oct 8 had eight posts and 4,607 impressions, Oct 21 had two and 3,254, Oct 12 had five and 1,385. Nothing went out on the last two weekends, and those were the four lowest days (515 to 1,023 impressions).

title: Cap nominee posts at one a day and ask each nominee to repost.
text: Through voting close on Oct 30, post at most one Top 20 nominee a day on LinkedIn, at a quiet hour, and keep guest interviews in the main slots. Send each nominee brand a ready caption and the post link the day it goes live, asking for a repost with their own words.
next_step: Measure: median impressions per nominee post against 239, and how many nominee brands repost (from the Reposts list).

title: Make two guest reels collabs and post one tagged vote carousel.
text: Invite the guest's company account as a collaborator on two guest reels, and tag the guest and company in the first line of the caption. Post one vote-reminder carousel that tags all 20 nominees, like the Oct 6 post.
next_step: Measure: reach per reel against the 198 median for single-guest reels; carousel reach and shares against the Oct 6 post (4,075 reach, 24 shares).

title: Post tags for October come from post text only.
text: Hannah's new feed has no per-post person, company or series tags, so posts from Oct 6 carry names read from the post text. Awards, newsroom and multi-guest posts come through without a name, which thins section D and the proof filters.
next_step: Add a tab to the feed with one row per post: date, channel, opening words, person, company, series.

title: Instagram reach is still falling.
text: 28-day reach is 30.0K, down 31% on the 28 days to Sep 24, and single-guest reels sit below September's per-post median.
next_step: Run the Instagram experiment in this week's editorial briefing and read the result on Nov 2.
